name: How long does it take to receive an exterior painting estimate after an initial consultation?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to receive an exterior painting estimate after an initial consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to receive an exterior painting estimate after an initial consultation can vary but typically ranges from 24 hours to a few business days. This timeframe allows the contractor to accurately assess the property, calculate material and labor costs, and compile a detailed proposal. Factors like property size, complexity, and current workload can influence this duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: After a consultation, you can expect an exterior painting estimate within 24 hours to a few business days.
